children.text: natural combat style progression template for players to follow.
Priorities can of course change depending on the content being done by the player. You should note that
when you upgrade weapons, you can sell the weapon being upgraded
to deduct cost from the new weapon.
If an item is not in the order
it was deemed not worth buying
As prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands,
the order is subject to change at any time
for a tailored list for the content that you do!
To make money to fund your first style early on, it is recommended to do either Croesus or easy clue scrolls.
This is a generalised order which assumes a starting point of T70 weapons and armour.
For further information on each upgrade check the relevant section in
For a checklist version, visit the RS Wiki page at
If you would like specialised advice, ask in
Stage 1: No Real Variance Based on Content
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip if mostly doing poison-immune content.
At this point try to finish the majority of unlocks in
Stage 2: Some Variance Based on Content/Wealth
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AS4 is a very strong perk in its own right. If you fail going for AS4E2, feel free to use AS4 in its place for the time being.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon getting Aftershock you'll now need it on all of your weapons for that style
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skip if not doing AoE content
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To make use of this ring, it is important to replace the Equilibrium perk with the Biting perk.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only upgrade to the full set all at once.
